maes_5.why: Trigonometry involves complex functions and requires a good grasp of ratios.

maes_6.why: Calculating area and volume needs knowledge of geometric formulas.

maes_7.why: Sketching curves demands understanding of function behavior and graphing skills.

maes_8.why: Working with fractions involves operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

maes_9.why: Determining missing side lengths often requires applying the Pythagorean theorem or similar triangles.
